```
1. ..."
gold: "...
6. finalize and publish"
q3b-int4 out: "...
3. finalize"
```

- sample 2k infill items stratified by anchor presence (1k anchor, 1k non-anchor)
- inject 5% golden labelled items across both strata
- run canary against q3b-int4 and baseline q3b-fp16 for comparison
- if anchor-specific regression > 1% absolute, pause rollout and roll back quant profile
